role_descriptions.mathematician: Biological-plausibility modeller. Start from the immutable C3-CAN-BALLISTIC-ANGULAR-JITTER-01 model. Diagnose the spatial donut quantitatively, test confounders, and formulate parsimonious falsifiable changes to spatial exploration without prescribing mechanisms.
role_descriptions.pluginist: OCaml/ABCA developer for biological plausibility. Create uniquely versioned descendants of frozen C3; preserve original, test determinism and coordinate/initialization fidelity; support trajectory XML exports for spatial PNG diagnostics.
role_descriptions.fitter: Parameter-fitting specialist. Calibrate candidate motion parameters only on authorized training XMLs; preserve parent parameters and expose parameter-bound/identifiability limitations. Do not fit to validation or held-out spatial images.
role_descriptions.runner: Independent trajectory-score evaluation operator. Receive five preregistered challenger XMLs and five untouched validation subsets; execute the unchanged evaluation wrapper. Spatial PNGs and simulation generation happen in the refinement workspace, never in evaluation.
role_descriptions.analyst: Independent trajectory-score evaluator; compare six fixed metrics and benchmark-relative gains, then incorporate only spatial diagnostic summaries and image-review provenance provided by the Orchestrator. Distinguish quantitative annularity checks from actual visual inspection and matched experimental evidence.
role_descriptions.orchestrator: Coordinate the biological-plausibility campaign around correction of the annular spatial artifact; maintain immutable C3 reference, require multi-seed spatial PNGs and radial diagnostics before acceptance, preserve separation between refinement and validation, and record all decisions.
